statement: For J=g*omega*exp(-omega/Lambda), no g,Lambda>0 and finite positive-residue auxiliary network without an E0 pole cancels Dprime,Dsecond,Dthird simultaneously. This obstruction precedes the separate stability test.

body: Use t=E0/Lambda,q=exp(-t)Ei(t). The source determinant numerator2Ac-3b^2 is a q-quadratic with leading coefficient -t^2*((t-2)^2+2) and discriminant4*(t^2-10t+1). It is negative on[1/8,9]; either the moment determinant or mu2 then fails. Below1/8 the explicit Ei/exp bounds give A<0. Above9, R=q-1/(t-1) satisfies Rprime=-R+1/[t(t-1)^2] with R(9)>0 from rational series, again A<0. All t>0 are covered analytically. The same claim does not apply to another smooth envelope, an active control or an additional open port.
